'''Chondrus Berani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] who led the [[New Imperial Guard]], an elite military force within the [[New Empire]] that protected the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Malgus]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Ilum|attack]] on the [[Emperor's Fortress]].<ref name="Emperor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chondrus Berani appeared in the flashpoint "The False Emperor" in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', published by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Emperor" />
